agent:Raydot technical review (2026-10-07): the material request currently checks its 64 MiB patch limit after Command::output has buffered the output, and GitRepository::snapshot_against also buffers patch output without a caller budget. The limit therefore does not bound peak memory. Add a request-specific bounded snapshot API that reuses apply_patch_facts, streams and caps stdout and stderr, kills and waits on overflow, excludes .ai from source patch identity, and returns a bounded canonical patch digest. Keep the existing snapshot API behavior unchanged. Bound the material request's ls-files, ls-tree, and cat-file reads as well. Scan committed blobs; check clean status, index flags, no-follow paths, and HEAD before and after observation. Do not compare raw checkout bytes to blob IDs because valid CRLF checkout bytes differ; this does not authenticate an adversarial local Git filter.
